column1: Weapons officer Mills says, "Before you shoot, I need to check the trigger pull on your weapon."
column2: 武器警員米爾斯說：「開槍前，我得檢查你這把槍的扳機扣力。」

column1: Ken takes your weapon and checks the trigger pull. He then hands it back to you and says...
column2: 肯拿起你的槍檢查扳機扣力，接著把槍還給你，說道……

column1: OK Bonds. Pick any open booth and obey all safety regulations while in the range.
column2: 「好了，邦茲。選一個空射擊台，並遵守靶場的所有安全規定。」

column1: Mills continues, "When you're ready, you can fire at will, and don't forget to see me for a new supply of ammo before leaving."
column2: 米爾斯繼續說：「準備好後就可以自由射擊；離開前別忘了來找我補充彈藥。」

column1: Thank you.
column2: 「謝謝。」

column1: Here you are, Ken says,"one pair of ear protectors. Just return them when you're through. "
column2: 「給你，」肯說，「這是一副護耳罩。用完後還回來就好。」

column1: You have them.
column2: 你已經拿到護耳罩。

column1: You are not close enough to the weapons officer.
column2: 你離武器警員還不夠近。

column1: You don't have any ammo clips with you.
column2: 你身上沒有任何彈匣。

column1: Ken says, "Use up your old ammo first."
column2: 肯說：「先把舊彈藥用完。」

column1: Ok, Bonds, says Mills, "here's one full clip of fresh ammo."
column2: 「好了，邦茲，」米爾斯說，「這是一個裝滿的新彈匣。」

column1: Ok, Bonds, says Mills, "Here's two full clips of fresh ammo."
column2: 「好了，邦茲，」米爾斯說，「這裡有兩個裝滿的新彈匣。」

column1: You should put on the ear protectors when you enter the booth.
column2: 進入射擊台時應戴上護耳罩。

column1: You don't have them.
column2: 你沒有護耳罩。

column1: You're not wearing ear protectors.
column2: 你沒有戴護耳罩。

column1: OK
column2: 好

column1: You experience excruciating pain.
column2: 你感到劇烈疼痛。

column1: As you pass out from loss of blood, you realize your error.
column2: 你因失血過多昏厥前，終於明白自己犯了什麼錯。

column1: A foot is a terrible thing to waste. Next time, draw your weapon fully before firing it.
column2: 浪費一隻腳可不是小事。下次開槍前，先把武器完全拔出。

column1: You should protect your ears.
column2: 你應該保護耳朵。

column1: FORGIVE ME FOR SHOUTING BUT, FAILURE TO USE EAR PROTECTORS HAS CAUSED SEVERE HEARING IMPAIRMENT. YOUR MEAGER DISABILITY PENSION IS SORRY COMPENSATION FOR THE CONSTANT RINGING IN YOUR EARS.
column2: 抱歉要用喊的，但不使用護耳罩已造成嚴重聽力損傷。你微薄的身心障礙撫卹金，根本補償不了耳中持續的耳鳴。

column1: You replace the old target with a new one from the shelf below the counter.
column2: 你從櫃檯下方的架子取出新標靶，換掉舊的。

column1: Practice your quick-draw later, Sonny; this is TARGET practice!
column2: 桑尼，快拔槍練習留到之後；現在是標靶射擊練習！

column1: CLICK!
column2: 喀！

column1: You had better bring the target up before it's so full of holes you can't tell them apart.
column2: 你最好趁標靶還沒被打得千瘡百孔前把它拉近，不然就分不清彈孔了。

column1: No fair! ANYBODY could hit it at this distance.
column2: 這不公平！距離這麼近，誰都打得到。

column1: A shelf beneath the table holds extra targets. The target is positioned by the buttons on the left wall.
column2: 桌下的架子放著備用標靶。標靶位置由左牆上的按鈕控制。

column1: The shelf has extra targets on it.
column2: 架子上放著備用標靶。

column1: Your gun is raised.
column2: 你舉起了槍。

column1: Wait a while.
column2: 等一下。

column1: Your gun is lowered.
column2: 你放下了槍。

column1: The target is too far away.
column2: 標靶太遠了。

column1: The target shows the accepted "kill" areas of the torso.
column2: 標靶顯示軀幹上認定的「致命」區域。

column1: You should replace the target and shoot again.
column2: 你應該換一個標靶再射擊。

column1: Your sights are properly aligned.
column2: 你的瞄具已正確對準。

column1: Your gun is shooting high%s.
column2: 你的槍擊發位置偏高%s。

column1: Your gun is shooting low%s.
column2: 你的槍擊發位置偏低%s。

column1: Your gun is shooting to the %s.
column2: 你的槍擊發位置偏向%s。

column1: There are two buttons on the wall of the booth. One is labeled 'VIEW', and the other is labeled 'BACK'.
column2: 射擊台牆上有兩個按鈕，一個標示為「查看」，另一個標示為「返回」。

column1: With what? The barrel of your gun? Lower your weapon first.
column2: 你要用什麼？用槍管嗎？先放下武器。

column1: This is as close as the target gets.
column2: 標靶只能拉近到這裡。
